description: Base icon primitive that renders Google Material Symbols via a span element with the material-symbols-outlined font class. Accepts a name prop (Material Symbols identifier), optional size (number or Tailwind h-* class), and fill boolean for filled vs. outlined style.
useCases: Rendering any Google Material Symbol icon by name in UI components
Base primitive consumed by the icons.tsx shim layer for named icon exports
Inline icon rendering with size control in buttons, labels, and list items
Icon-only buttons and icon badges with accessible aria-label
